name: dirly
description: Smart plant soil moisture monitoring. ESP32 + MQTT + Fastify + Prisma + PostgreSQL, dashboard React (Vite/Tailwind/Recharts).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dirly/shared && npm run build -w @dirly/api && npm run build -w @dirly/web
scripts.build:vercel: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @dirly/shared && npm run build:serverless -w @dirly/api && npm run db:seed && npm run build -w @dirly/web
